svg.title: FIG-24 Current retained-clock / Stop2 software Exact TZEN0 reference; physical and autonomous exits remain open
svg.desc: Ownership: explicitly assembled and serialized; External boot / Board Valid crystal LSE + calendar / PC13 silence No concurrent source or clock-profile writer; Caller-owned retained storage Independent nx_clock_t / identity / generation Read-only coherent tuple helper; Exact Stop2 owner Delegated WUT + RTC IRQ only Own RCC / PWR additions and restoration; RUN owners / ClockDomain Close admission; end Core deadlines; stop Platform Join producers / observers; release drained leases; Default Core TIM2 Old domain invalid after stop Fresh restart has a new epoch; supplies preserved source; no source writes; supplies stable wake identity; checks generation; exact enrolled barrier; no implicit drain; stopping invalidates old Core deadlines; Wake lifecycle: hardware effects remain owned until real drain; QUIET Bound live retained clock Verified source + RUN access profile; ARMED / WFI WUTWF observed / WPR relocked PRIMASK held; WFI is not residency proof; DRAIN Verify RUN profile before clock read Withdraw WUT / RTC IRQ / added gates; RETAINED EFFECTS Domain stays closed / storage stays live No failed cleanup revokes ownership; TAINTED CLOCK Checked sample reports failure Clock face faults and parks; no stale return; arm after source / barrier admission; wake or failed setup; drain / restoration complete; same live clock epoch; drain / restoration fails; recover: retry drain; no WFI; clock read sees source / profile / elapsed bound invalid; hardware isolated; clock epoch remains invalid; Open exits: require separate implementation and physical proof LPDMA / LPBAM + SRAM4/domain admission Stop2 retention / current / latency / oscillator accuracy; software mechanism alone does not establish these exits
